_comment: Policy for scripts/dependabot-automerge.sh, the sweeper that arms auto-merge on the open Dependabot PRs in the org. The sweeper arms a pull request only when each update in it is a patch or a minor update. A major update waits for a person (owner decision of 2026-10-05). Auto-merge NEVER bypasses a required check: GitHub holds the PR until the gate is green and merges it then, so the merge gate remains the only thing deciding what lands. The lists below are escape hatches, empty on purpose — the owner's standing preference is to be on the latest of everything. Add a repo to exclude_repos to stop arming it, or a dependency name to exclude_dependencies to keep bumps of one package manual (useful if a package ever needs a human read of every diff). Both match the whole string, case-insensitively.
